mechanics.description_raw: Increase ATK by 12%. Dealing DMG to targets with Spectro Frazzle grants the wielder 14% Basic Attack DMG Bonus and 14% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus, stacking up to 3 times for 6s. Casting Outro Skill amplifies the Spectro Frazzle DMG on targets around the active Resonator by 30% for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.
